evidence.note: Bounds are the smallest and largest of three measurements, not a distribution.
observed: This profile was asked for on the understanding that boom bap carries a much heavier 60 to 250 band than guaracha. It does not, in these references. The band runs 18.37 to 36.22 percent here against 23.64 to 35.93 for guaracha, and the lightest of the two sets is one of these. The heavier figure was quoted, not measured, and this file records the measurement instead.

excluded.title: Travis Scott featuring Drake, SICKO MODE, Upgrade Bootleg
excluded.why: a bootleg re-edit rather than a released master, and an outlier on every loudness field: minus 4.8 LUFS against minus 8.4 to minus 9.7 for the other three, plus 3.2 dBTP, 63732 clipped runs and 627823 samples over full scale. Keeping it would have widened every bound with damage that is not the style's.

loudness.lra_lu.advisory: loudness range follows the arrangement and the section structure more than the style. Across these three it runs 3.3 to 5.7 LU, which is too wide to check a master against, so it is reported as information and no verdict is claimed.

loudness.true_peak_dbtp.declared_by: the person this bench is for, as a delivery ceiling
loudness.true_peak_dbtp.why_not_seeded: the references are lossy. Decoding overshoots the encoder's peak and every one of them reads over full scale, so a ceiling cannot be measured from them. This bound is a rule, not evidence.

withheld.loudness.sample_peak_dbfs: the references are lossy and all of them decode above full scale, so they cannot say where a peak sits.
withheld.spectral.band_pct.16000_20000: the references are lowpassed by the encoder near 16 kHz, so this band holds the encoder's setting rather than the music.
withheld.stereo.correlation: joint stereo coding rebuilds the side signal, so correlation from an mp3 is the codec's, not the master's.
withheld.tempo.bpm: the three references measure 139.98, 150.02 and 168.98 BPM. Tracks are meant to differ in tempo, so the range across them is not something a master can be checked against. This is the same reason folder mode prints no tempo spread.
withheld.tempo.drift.span_bpm: only one of the three moves enough to measure, and that one moves 16.41 BPM because it changes beat partway through. One value is not a bound.
